info.name: LTSICON Chennai 2026 — Backend API
info.description:
Abstract submission + delegate registration endpoints.

Import this, then run the requests top to bottom. The {{baseUrl}} variable defaults to http://localhost:4000 and {{reference}} is set automatically by the 'Register (step 1)' request so the confirm request can reuse it.

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "Asha",
  "lastName": "Rao",
  "email": "asha.rao@example.org",
  "mobile": "+91 99999 88888",
  "institution": "Apollo Hospitals",
  "coAuthors": "Dr B Kumar, Dr C Nair",
  "membershipId": "LTSI-2291",
  "presentationType": "Oral",
  "track": "Hepatology",
  "title": "Outcomes in living donor liver transplantation",
  "abstractBody": "Background. Methods. Results. Conclusion.",
  "keywords": "liver, transplant, outcomes",
  "declarations": [
    "Abstract is original, unpublished and not under review elsewhere.",
    "All listed authors have approved the submission."
  ]
}

formdata.description: Pick any PDF/DOCX. Only its metadata (name, size, type) is stored.

request.description:
Same endpoint, multipart/form-data. Select a file for the 'file' key in the Body tab.
File metadata is saved to file_name / file_size / file_mime; the binary is not persisted. Max 15 MB.

exec: console.log('Saved reference for next request:', b.reference);

request.description:
What the frontend sends at step 1. Creates a 'pending' row and sends the 'Registration received' email.

Re-sending the same reference updates the row instead of erroring, so it's safe to run twice.
If you omit 'reference', the server generates one and returns it.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Dr Asha Rao",
  "email": "asha.rao@example.org",
  "phone": "+91 99999 88888",
  "designation": "Consultant Surgeon",
  "institution": "Apollo Hospitals",
  "category": "LTSI Member",
  "workshops": ["Robotic Surgery Workshop", "Hands-on Microsurgery"],
  "guests": [{ "name": "Guest One", "mobile": "+91 90000 11111" }],
  "currency": "INR",
  "totalAmount": 29000,
  "phase": "early",
  "paid": true
}

request.description:
What the frontend sends when the delegate hits 'Pay'. Fills in category/workshops/guests/total,
sets payment_status='paid' and sends the 'Registration confirmed' email.

{{reference}} is auto-filled from request #4. Run #4 first, or paste a reference in manually.
Deliberately invalid. Proves validation works — expect 400 and a list of field errors.
